safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling/numbness in the shoulder; generated mentions shoulder pain with movement but not shoulder tingling/numbness (hpi-003).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness removes a potentially important localization detail (e.g., more proximal nerve involvement or cervical radiculopathy vs distal entrapment), which could affect diagnostic focus and follow-up questions/exam. However, the core complaint of progressive left arm numbness/tingling and weakness is still captured, so immediate safety impact is limited.

Its omission could lead to an incomplete history and missed contributing diagnoses, though the episode appears historical and resolved.
